messages:
anika: heads up — spotted a replayed KMS unwrap on the onprem control plane during the 02:00 maintenance window. same request_id seen twice, nonce identical. not sure if leak or client retry bug.
liam: can you paste the KMS logs + request_id?
anika: snippet pasted below and full archive uploaded to s3://redwood-incidents/2624/replay-logs.tar.gz:
```
kms unwrap request_id=abc123 nonce=0x9f7c4a status=OK
kms unwrap request_id=abc123 nonce=0x9f7c4a status=OK
```
maya: :eyes: that looks like a replay. do we have matching audit entries from private-controlplane?
anika: audit shows session create by user=onprem-deploy@infra, token=svc-rotator, and a session_extend for the same session_id around the same time. audit lines:
```
audit: session_id=sedf user=onprem-deploy action=session_extend reason=kv-sync
audit: auth:token_issue id=svc-rotator scope=admin:deploy,kms:unwrap
```
security-oncall: can svc-rotator perform admin ops or is it scoped to deployment chores only?
liam: svc-rotator currently has admin:deploy and kms:unwrap in onprem. could be either a compromised credential or a replay bug in the unwrap flow.
sre-bot: deploy-rollback triggered for controlplane v2.1.4 -> rolled back to v2.1.3 by infra-bot at 02:20 UTC
infra-bot: rollback complete. service health: degraded -> stable. logs: https://internal/logs/2624000123
alex: containment plan (quick): 1) rotate onprem master wrapping key, 2) revoke all svc-rotator sessions, 3) disable svc-rotator client until root cause identified. i'll open INCIDENT-2026-45.
anika: starting session revokes now. kicking off KMS rotate request — ETA ~20m. question: will rotating the key break active dedicated/onprem customers? need confirmation before immediate rotation.
maya: avoid a full key rotation if it will break customers. prefer targeted session revocation + forced rewrap for active sessions if possible. can we revoke by session id?
liam: yes — we have a session registry. running: `./ctl sessions revoke --match 'svc-rotator'`
anika: revoked 12 sessions matching svc-rotator. patching auth-service to enforce nonce monotonicity on token unwrap path. pushing hotfix to staging now.
security-oncall: also open IGA audit for the service account perms. add non-repudiation / nonce checks to KMS unwrap path and a monitoring alert on duplicate request_id.
alex: incident created: https://incidents.internal/INC-2026-45 assigned to @anika @liam priority=P1
anika: creating draft playbook steps in the incident: containment actions, customer impact check, audit log retention extension, and postmortem owners.
liam: added logrotate fix to avoid dropping audit lines; PR #5512 opened with logrotate config change and retention bump.
maya: add regression test that replays an unwrap and asserts nonce rejection. put it in eng-ml/ci or infra-test harness.
anika: agreed — adding tests and telemetry. preliminary RCA expected within 48h, full postmortem in 72h.
liam: also adding a short-term alert: duplicate-kms-unwrap -> page security-oncall + eng-infra.
anika: thanks everyone. followups will happen in INC-2026-45. closing thread here; ping me in the incident if you need anything. :heart:
